page.overview:
Who is Carandini?

Carandini was a necromancer native to the Tilean city-state of Miragliano, reputed to be a sorcerer who practiced the dark arts. He was rumoured to live in one of the easternmost neighborhoods of Miragliano, a semi-abandoned district full of crumbling houses.

Brunner the Bounty Hunter was sent by the Vampire Lord Carlotta de Villarias to Carandini's lair, to interrupt his studies on an ancient Nehekharan mummy. He had his run-ins with the necromancer's servants but reached his laboratory where the embalmed body of the Tomb King rested. Brunner was about to destroy the mummy with a stake but Carandini interrupted him, attacking him with his magic; but Brunner managed to defend himself and put the necromancer in danger of his life to the point that Carandini was forced to threaten to shoot a vial with a highly explosive alchemical substance that could kill both of them.

That stalemate was immediately interrupted when Nehb-ka-menthu's corpse awoke.

Brunner began to retreat before the Undead abomination, until he ended up next to Carandini. Brunner noticed that the necromancer was paralysed by terror, to the point that he did not realise that the bottle had fallen on him and broken open but with no ill effects; revealing his deception. Brunner plunged his blade Dragon Malice into the necromancer's belly as payment for his bluff.
